title: fMRI of Active DBS Stimulation in Epilepsy
brief_summary: Researchers are trying to incorporate a process known as Functional MRI (fMRI) scanning to reveal a pattern in brain activity during Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS), which will correlate to possible seizure freedom.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Patients selected to undergo anterior thalamic nucleus DBS for refractory epilepsy

Exclusion Criteria

* Contraindication to MRI
